rationale: naf-claude-agentic: val_n=214, naf_encoding=hash, naf_hash_levels=16, naf_hash_feat_dim=2, naf_hash_log2_size=19, naf_hash_base_res=16, naf_hash_max_res=512, naf_n_freqs=8, naf_hidden=64, naf_layers=3, naf_n_iter=3000, naf_lr=0.02, naf_tv_weight=0.0001, naf_n_clip=0.05, naf_outer_wall_s=1080, naf_per_scene_s=5.0, seed=42, rationale=ITER-7 (search-20260619-01, naf). SIX-BOX (NUMBERS, not CT pixels). (1) TRAJECTORY + current hash/MLP cfg (all hr=0): iter-1 fourier hidden=128 layers=4 lr=1e-2 -> SSIM 0.4729 (PSNR 18.55). iter-2 hidden 128->64 -> 0.4943 (+0.0215). iter-3 layers 4->3 -> 0.5452 (+0.0509). iter-4 lr 1e-2->2e-2 -> 0.5629 (PSNR 20.28) = BEST FOURIER. iter-5 lr 2e-2->4e-2 -> 0.3592 REGRESSED (lr lever exhausted). iter-6 audit-fix (A) naf_encoding fourier->hash (Instant-NGP 16-level multi-res hash grid feeding a SMALL MLP hidden=32 layers=3 lr=2e-2) -> SSIM 0.6715 (+0.1086, PSNR 23.35, RMSE 0.003399, params 16.78M, elapsed 1101s, ~scene 214 at the 5.0s per-scene wall) = NEW BEST, hr STILL 0. Current cfg = iter-6 hash: encoding=hash, hash_levels=16, feat_dim=2, log2_size=19, base_res=16, max_res=512, hidden=32, layers=3, lr=2e-2, n_iter=3000(cap), per_scene_s=5.0, outer_wall_s=1080, val_n=214. (2) LIMITER: NAF is REGIME-BOUNDED on DENSE 2304-view Mayo -- LD-FBP is near-complete, so the audit (mayo_campaign_state.md NAF bullet) says the hash fix makes the impl FAITHFUL but is UNLIKELY to clear hr>0 here; the payoff is the 128-view SPARSE benchmarks. The audit DEFERS fix (B) (more steps/scene, under-budget) until after the TPE run -- so the step count / wall is OFF-LIMITS this iter. WITHIN that budget the in-budget lever is the hash/MLP hyperparams. iter-6 paired the rich 16-level hash encoder (32-dim concatenated feature, 16.78M params nearly all in the tables) with a DELIBERATELY tiny 32-wide MLP (the reference small MLP). The remaining suspected bottleneck on dense Mayo is the small MLP UNDER-DECODING that 32-dim hash feature. (3) ONE KNOB: naf_hidden 32->64 (naf_encoding=hash, naf_layers=3, all hash table knobs feat_dim/levels/log2_size/base_res/max_res UNCHANGED, lr=2e-2, per_scene_s=5.0, outer_wall_s=1080, val_n=214 ALL UNCHANGED -- step count / wall UNTOUCHED, that is the deferred B-fix). Width 32->64 is a MATMUL-ONLY change (the one hidden->hidden block goes 32x32->64x64 plus the in 32->64 and out 64->1); per-step cost stays DOMINATED by the fixed 2304-view fan-beam forward+backward, so the ~90-100 Adam steps/scene in the 5.0s per-scene wall stay comparable -- the knob is ~free on the wall. Isolates: is the small MLP under-decoding the hash feature on dense Mayo? (4) HYPOTHESIS: if naf_hidden 32->64, SSIM rises above 0.6715 because a wider MLP decodes the 32-dim multi-res hash feature more expressively within the same per-scene step budget. NUMERIC FALSIFIER: if SSIM <= 0.6715, the hash/MLP-width hyperparam is EXHAUSTED within the current budget on dense Mayo -- the hash-NAF ceiling here is ~0.67 SSIM (well below the LD-FBP ~0.81 cal floor, hr 0), a STRUCTURAL NEGATIVE on dense 2304-view Mayo (regime-bounded; real payoff is the SPARSE benchmarks), document toward iter-20; the lever then moves to feat_dim or hash_levels. (5) SIZE to HARD 1200s budget: 214-scene pass, outer_wall_s=1080 (18-min in-solver outer wall = governor) + per_scene_s=5.0 (in-solver per-scene wall; n_iter=3000 stays a HIGH CAP so the WALL governs). STEP COUNT KEPT at iter-6 value (per_scene_s 5.0, n_iter cap 3000 UNCHANGED -- raising it is the DEFERRED B-fix; I did NOT touch it). 214x5.0s=1070s ~= 1080s outer wall (hit ~scene 214 every iter; measured elapsed 1094-1101s, inside the 30-min sbatch kill). The hidden 32->64 change is ~free on the wall. val_n=214 (ALL L277 slices), staged_canonical v3 mayo_ldct_fitted geometry, per-sample-ps (inlined single-val-ps probe -> L277 native ps ~0.73979), bg_target=truth, 321px detector-geometry FOV default (no fov= override), naf_encoding=hash kept. (6) no control return; the loop dispatches the next iter.
